defmodule Feed.Cursor do
  @moduledoc """
  An opaque, tamper-evident cursor codec.

  Cursors must be URL-safe Base64 strings matching `~r/\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/`. They
  include a checksum so that any modification or hand-assembly yields
  `{:error, :invalid_cursor}`.
  """

  @doc """
  Encodes a payload map into a URL-safe Base64 cursor string.

  The payload must contain exactly the keys `:feed` (an atom), `:direction`
  (`:next` or `:prev`) and `:keyset` (a UTF-8 binary).

  Encoding the same map twice produces the same string.
  """
  @spec encode(map()) :: String.t()
  def encode(%{feed: feed, direction: direction, keyset: keyset} = payload)
      when is_atom(feed) and direction in [:next, :prev] and is_binary(keyset) and
             map_size(payload) == 3 do
    # Include a checksum (SHA-256) of the term for tamper-evidence.
    payload
    |> :erlang.term_to_binary(compressed: 9)
    |> :crypto.hash(:sha256)
    |> then(&Base.url_encode64(&1 <> :erlang.term_to_binary(payload), padding: false))
  end

  @doc """
  Decodes a cursor string into a payload map, or `{:error, :invalid_cursor}`.

  Never raises. Detects corruption: changing any character of, or removing a
  character from, a valid cursor, or hand-assembling a payload, yields an
  invalid cursor error.
  """
  @spec decode(any()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  def decode(cursor) when is_binary(cursor) do
    with {:ok, <<checksum::binary-32, payload_bin::binary>>} <- decode_cursor(cursor),
         {:ok, ^checksum} <- {:ok, :crypto.hash(:sha256, payload_bin)},
         payload <- :erlang.binary_to_term(payload_bin),
         true <- valid_payload?(payload) do
      {:ok, payload}
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  rescue
    _ -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
  end

  def decode(_), do: {:error, :invalid_cursor}

  defp decode_cursor(cursor) do
    if String.match?(cursor, ~r/\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/) do
      case Base.url_decode64(cursor, padding: false) do
        {:ok, decoded} -> {:ok, decoded}
        :error -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
      end
    else
      {:error, :invalid_cursor}
    end
  end

  defp valid_payload?(payload) do
    is_map(payload) and map_size(payload) == 3 and is_atom(payload.feed) and
      payload.direction in [:next, :prev] and is_binary(payload.keyset)
  end
end

  The paging API layer.
  """

  alias Feed.{Timeline, Cursor}

  @type feed_name :: :feed | :public_feed | :hot_feed | :heat_feed | :author_feed
  @type opts :: [limit: pos_integer(), cursor: String.t(), author_id: String.t()]

  @feed_actions [
    :feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed, :author_feed, :strict_feed,
    :uncounted_feed, :flexible_feed
  ]

  @doc """
  Fetches a single page of activities for a feed.
  """
  @spec fetch(feed_name(), opts()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, any()}
  def fetch(feed_name, opts \\ [])
      when feed_name in [:feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed, :author_feed] do
    limit = opts[:limit]
    cursor = opts[:cursor]
    author_id = opts[:author_id]

    with {:ok, action} <- validate_feed_action(feed_name, author_id),
         {:ok, pagination} <- validate_pagination(action, limit, cursor),
         {:ok, page} <- perform_query(action, pagination, author_id) do
      items = page.results
      items = Enum.map(items, fn i -> i |> Map.put(:author, i.author) |> Map.put(:reaction_count, i.reaction_count) |> Map.put(:heat, i.heat) end)
      
      {next_cursor, prev_cursor} = build_cursors(feed_name, page)

      {:ok, %{items: items, next_cursor: next_cursor, prev_cursor: prev_cursor, total: page.count, has_next: page.more?, has_prev: prev_cursor != nil}}
    end
  end

  def fetch(feed_name, _), do: {:error, {:unknown_feed, feed_name}}

  defp validate_feed_action(:author_feed, nil), do: {:error, :author_id_required}
  defp validate_feed_action(:author_feed, author_id) when is_binary(author_id), do: {:ok, :author_feed}
  defp validate_feed_action(name, _) when name in [:feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed], do: {:ok, name}
  defp validate_feed_action(name, _), do: {:error, {:unknown_feed, name}}

  defp validate_pagination(action, nil, nil), do: {:ok, []}
  defp validate_pagination(_action, limit, _cursor) when not (limit == nil or (is_integer(limit) and limit > 0)), do: {:error, :invalid_limit}
  defp validate_pagination(action, limit, cursor) when limit != nil or cursor != nil do
    # For simplicity, let Ash validate the limit against the action's max_page_size.
    # Actually, we can check the limit here. Let's do a light check.
    # Or, let Ash return the error. The requirement says:
    # "A limit greater than that feed action's configured maximum page size returns {:error, {:limit_too_large, max}} where max is that configured maximum."
    # So we should check. Let's use the resource info to get the max.
    case get_max_page_size(action) do
      nil -> {:ok, build_page_opts(limit, cursor)}
      max when limit != nil and limit > max -> {:error, {:limit_too_large, max}}
      _ -> {:ok, build_page_opts(limit, cursor)}
    end
  end

  defp get_max_page_size(action) do
    resource = Feed.Timeline.Activity
    Ash.Resource.Info.action(resource, action) |> get_in([:pagination, :max_page_size])
  end

  defp build_page_opts(limit, cursor), do: Keyword.drop([limit: limit, after: cursor, before: cursor], [nil])

  # The cursor contains direction and keyset. So if cursor is next, use after: keyset. If prev, use before: keyset.
  # Wait, how to pass direction? The cursor needs to be decoded first.
  # Let me rethink. The fetch receives a cursor string.
  # We need to decode it.
  # But we also need to know the direction, to pass after: keyset (for next) or before: keyset (for prev).
  # Let's decode the cursor here.

  defp build_page_opts_with_direction(limit, nil), do: limit && [limit: limit] || []
  defp build_page_opts_with_direction(limit, cursor) do
    opts = limit && [limit: limit] || []
    case Cursor.decode(cursor) do
      {:ok, %{direction: :next, keyset: keyset}} -> opts ++ [after: keyset]
      {:ok, %{direction: :prev, keyset: keyset}} -> opts ++ [before: keyset]
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

    with {:ok, limit} <- validate_limit(action, limit),
         {:ok, opts} <- build_page_opts_correct(limit, cursor) do
      {:ok, opts}
    end

defmodule Feed.Api do
  @moduledoc """
  The paging API layer.
  """

  alias Feed.{Timeline, Cursor}

  @type feed_name :: :feed | :public_feed | :hot_feed | :heat_feed | :author_feed
  @type opts :: [limit: pos_integer(), cursor: String.t(), author_id: String.t()]

  @doc """
  Fetches a single page of activities for a feed.
  """
  @spec fetch(feed_name(), opts()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, any()}
  def fetch(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    limit = opts[:limit]
    cursor = opts[:cursor]
    author_id = opts[:author_id]

    with {:ok, action} <- validate_feed_action(feed_name, author_id),
         {:ok, limit} <- validate_limit(action, limit),
         {:ok, page_opts} <- build_page_opts(limit, cursor),
         {:ok, page} <- perform_query(action, page_opts, author_id) do
      items = Enum.map(page.results, fn i -> 
        i |> Map.put(:author, i.author) |> Map.put(:reaction_count, i.reaction_count) |> Map.put(:heat, i.heat) 
      end)
      
      {next, prev, has_next, has_prev} = build_cursors(feed_name, cursor, author_id, page)

      {:ok, %{items: items, next_cursor: next, prev_cursor: prev, total: page.count, has_next: has_next, has_prev: has_prev}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_feed_action(:author_feed, author_id) when is_binary(author_id), do: {:ok, :author_feed}
  defp validate_feed_action(:author_feed, _), do: {:error, :author_id_required}
  defp validate_feed_action(name, _) when name in [:feed, :public_feed, :hot_feed, :heat_feed], do: {:ok, name}
  defp validate_feed_action(name, _), do: {:error, {:unknown_feed, name}}

  defp validate_limit(_, nil), do: {:ok, nil}
  defp validate_limit(action, limit) when not (is_integer(limit) and limit > 0), do: {:error, :invalid_limit}
  defp validate_limit(action, limit) do
    max = get_max_page_size(action)
    if max && limit > max, do: {:error, {:limit_too_large, max}}, else: {:ok, limit}
  end

  defp get_max_page_size(action) do
    Ash.Resource.Info.action(Feed.Timeline.Activity, action) |> get_in([:pagination, :max_page_size])
  end

  defp build_page_opts(limit, nil), do: {:ok, limit && [limit: limit] || []}
  defp build_page_opts(limit, cursor) do
    case Cursor.decode(cursor) do
      {:error, :invalid_cursor} -> {:error, :invalid_cursor}
      {:ok, %{feed: f, direction: dir, keyset: k}} -> {:ok, limit && [limit: limit, after: (dir == :next && k), before: (dir == :prev && k)] |> Keyword.drop([false, nil]) || [after: (dir == :next && k), before: (dir == :prev && k)] |> Keyword.drop([false, nil])}
    end
  end

    opts = Keyword.update(opts, :load, [:author, :reaction_count, :heat], &(&1 ++ [:author, :reaction_count, :heat]))
    query = Ash.Query.new(Feed.Timeline.Activity) 
    query = if author_id, do: Ash.Query.filter(query, author_id: author_id), else: query
    query = Ash.Query.for_action(query, action) |> Ash.Query.page(opts)

        next = has_next && Cursor.encode(%{feed: feed_name, direction: :next, keyset: List.last(keyset_data)}) || nil
        {next, prev, has_next, has_prev}
    end

    filter = before_filter(name, f)
    Feed.Timeline.read(Ash.Query.filter(base, ^filter), count?: true).count
  end

    filter = after_filter(name, f)
    Feed.Timeline.read(Ash.Query.filter(base, ^filter), count?: true).count
  end

  defp base_query(:public_feed, nil), do: Ash.Query.filter(Ash.Query.new(Feed.Timeline.Activity), visibility: :public)
  defp base_query(:author_feed, author_id), do: Ash.Query.filter(Ash.Query.new(Feed.Timeline.Activity), author_id: author_id)

  defp before_filter(name, f) when name in [:feed, :public_feed, :author_feed],
    do: expr(published_at > ^f.published_at or (published_at == ^f.published_at and id < ^f.id))

  defp before_filter(:heat_feed, f), do: expr(heat > ^f.heat or (heat == ^f.heat and id < ^f.id))

  defp after_filter(name, f)
  defp after_filter(name, f) when name in [:feed, :public_feed, :author_feed],
    do: expr(published_at < ^f.published_at or (published_at == ^f.published_at and id > ^f.id))
  defp after_filter(:hot_feed, f), do: expr(score < ^f.score or (score == ^f.score and reaction_count < ^f.reaction_count) or (score == ^f.score and reaction_count == ^f.reaction_count and id > ^f.id))
  defp after_filter(:heat_feed, f), do: expr(heat < ^f.heat or (heat == ^f.heat and id > ^f.id))

  def walk(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    {limit, cursor, author_id} = {opts[:limit], opts[:cursor], opts[:author_id]}
    loop_walk(feed_name, limit, cursor, author_id, [], nil)
  end

  defp loop_walk(name, limit, cursor, author_id, pages, total) do
    case fetch(name, limit: limit, cursor: cursor, author_id: author_id) do
      {:error, _} = err -> err
      {:ok, %{items: items, next_cursor: next, total: t}} ->
        total = total || t
        pages = pages ++ [Enum.map(items, & &1.id)]
        if next == nil, do: {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}}, else: loop_walk(name, limit, next, author_id, pages, total)
    end
  end

  def walk_back(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    case walk(feed_name, opts) do
      {:error, _} = err -> err
      {:ok, %{pages: pages, total: total}} -> {:ok, %{pages: Enum.reverse(pages), total: total}}
    end
  end
end

defmodule Feed.Api do
  @moduledoc """
  The paging API layer.
  """

  alias Feed.Timeline
  alias Feed.Cursor
  import Ash.Expr, only: [expr: 1]
  import Ash.Query, only: [filter: 2]

  @type feed_name :: :feed | :public_feed | :hot_feed | :heat_feed | :author_feed
  @type opts :: [limit: pos_integer(), cursor: String.t(), author_id: String.t()]

  @doc """
  Fetches a single page of activities for a feed.
  """
  @spec fetch(feed_name(), opts()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, any()}
  def fetch(feed_name, opts \\ []) do
    limit = opts[:limit]
    cursor = opts[:cursor]
    author_id = opts[:author_id]

    with {:ok, action} <- validate_feed_action(feed_name, author_id),
         {:ok, limit} <- validate_limit(action, limit),
